title: Skin Care for Outdoor Workers in India: Sun, Sweat and Dust Made Simple
ex: A low-cost, five-minute routine for farmers, site workers, delivery riders and anyone who works outside all day in Indian sun, sweat and dust.
rt: Skin Care for Outdoor Workers in India: Easy Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for outdoor workers in India: cover up and sunscreen by day, gentle cleansing and moisture at night, plus hands, lips and seasonal tips.
quick: Outdoor workers should cover up with a hat and full-sleeve cotton clothes, wear broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen on open skin and reapply at breaks. In the evening, rinse off sweat and dust with a gentle face wash, dry skin folds fully and moisturise face, hands and lips.
facts: Clothing and shade do most of the sun protection outdoors
Reapply sunscreen at least once at the lunch break
Tan fades slowly over weeks; no cream removes it overnight
Wash off cement and farm chemicals quickly and see a doctor for burns or rashes
